Privacy

This notice is a plain-language summary for Veylet Studio (Australia). It is not legal advice.

Enquiries. Apply and request forms go to yoda@yodalai.xyz via FormSubmit. Use them to assess a walkthrough or operator application. Do not send access codes, identity documents or private client images.

Accounts. Signing in with an email address either returns you to an account that already exists for that address or creates one — there is no separate sign-up step, and the first sign-in is the account being made. It is a hosted identity so the same person can use the website and the iPhone app. Identity and related records are stored with Supabase in Sydney (ap-southeast-2). Sign-in is not operator approval and is not payment. We never merge two accounts that share an email address.

Your records. Spaces you save hold a name, a category and a suburb or city. They must not hold a street address, unit number, access code, identity document or private client image, and the desk rejects an address-shaped location. Ask us to delete the account and its records at any time; we confirm before removing anything.

Tour files. When you send a reconstructed tour from Veylet Capture, the package is stored privately under your account. Only you can open your own tours until you create a client handoff. Street addresses, access codes and ID documents do not belong in these records.

Client handoff links. A handoff is an unlisted link you choose to create for one tour. Anyone holding that link can open the walkthrough; it asks the client for no account, and Revoke stops it working. Handoff and preview pages are excluded from search engines. Do not pass a link to anyone who should not see the space.

We do not sell personal information. We do not run advertising cookies or a public analytics product on this site today. Hosting logs may exist at Cloudflare, Vercel and Supabase. Intended card payments use Square after assessment; this public site does not collect card numbers.

Ask to access, correct or delete your account data: yoda@yodalai.xyz. We keep enquiry mail as needed to assess a job, then no longer than the work requires.
